```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": 12.0, "L_in": 0.3, "I_tail": 240e-6,
    "gmid_casn": 12.0, "gmid_casp": 12.0, "L_cas": 0.3,
    "gmid_src": 8.0, "L_src": 0.6, "I_out": 100e-6,
}

_GLOBAL_CANDS = [
    ("size_device", lambda: size_device), ("gmid_size", lambda: gmid_size),
    ("size_fet", lambda: size_fet), ("size_mos", lambda: size_mos),
    ("size_transistor", lambda: size_transistor), ("mos", lambda: mos),
    ("fet", lambda: fet), ("nmos", lambda: nmos), ("pmos", lambda: pmos),
    ("Mos", lambda: Mos), ("MOS", lambda: MOS), ("Fet", lambda: Fet),
    ("Transistor", lambda: Transistor), ("Device", lambda: Device),
    ("design", lambda: design), ("sizing", lambda: sizing),
    ("lut", lambda: lut), ("LUT", lambda: LUT), ("gmid_lut", lambda: gmid_lut),
    ("size_by_gmid", lambda: size_by_gmid), ("gmid_to_w", lambda: gmid_to_w),
    ("lookup", lambda: lookup), ("db", lambda: db), ("tech", lambda: tech),
]

def _call_forms(f, kind, gm_id, L, Id):
    forms = [
        lambda: f(kind, gm_id=gm_id, L=L, Id=Id),
        lambda: f(kind, gmid=gm_id, L=L, id=Id),
        lambda: f(kind, gm_id, L, Id),
        lambda: f(type=kind, gm_id=gm_id, L=L, Id=Id),
        lambda: f(kind=kind, gmid=gm_id, L=L, Id=Id),
        lambda: f.size(kind, gm_id=gm_id, L=L, Id=Id),
        lambda: f.size(kind, gm_id, L, Id),
    ]
    for g in forms:
        try:
            r = g()
            if r is not None:
                return r
        except:
            pass
    return None

class _Resolver:
    def __init__(self):
        self.report = []
        self.found = None
        for name, getf in _GLOBAL_CANDS:
            try:
                f = getf()
            except:
                continue
            self.report.append(name + "(defined)")
            if _call_forms(f, "nfet", 10.0, 0.3, 10e-6) is not None:
                self.found = f
                break
            self.report.append(name + "(call failed)")

    def __call__(self, kind, gm_id, L, Id):
        if self.found is None:
            return {}["NO_SIZER; defined/failed: " + ", ".join(self.report)]
        r = _call_forms(self.found, kind, gm_id, L, Id)
        if r is None:
            return {}["SIZER_CALL_FAILED for " + kind]
        return r

def _vgs(m):
    for g in (lambda: abs(m.vgs), lambda: abs(m["vgs"]), lambda: abs(m.Vgs)):
        try:
            return g()
        except:
            pass
    return 0.75

def build(p):
    sz = _Resolver()
    n = Netlist(["vinp", "vinn", "out", "vdd", "vss", "ibias"])
    It, Io = p["I_tail"], p["I_out"]
    Ifold = It / 2 + Io
    m_in  = sz("nfet", p["gmid_in"],  p["L_in"],  It / 2)
    m_tl  = sz("nfet", p["gmid_src"], p["L_src"], It)
    m_ref = sz("nfet", p["gmid_src"], p["L_src"], 10e-6)
    m_pf  = sz("pfet", p["gmid_src"], p["L_src"], Ifold)
    m_pc  = sz("pfet", p["gmid_casp"], p["L_cas"], Io)
    m_nc  = sz("nfet", p["gmid_casn"], p["L_cas"], Io)
    m_nm  = sz("nfet", p["gmid_src"], p["L_src"], Io)

    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_ref)
    n.dev("M0", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m_tl)
    n.dev("M1", "f1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M2", "f2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m_in)
    n.dev("M3", "f1", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m_pf)
    n.dev("M4", "f2", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", m_pf)
    n.dev("M5", "c1", "vbpc", "f1", "vdd", m_pc)
    n.dev("M6", "out", "vbpc", "f2", "vdd", m_pc)
    n.dev("M7", "c1", "vbnc", "s1", "vss", m_nc)
    n.dev("M8", "out", "vbnc", "s2", "vss", m_nc)
    n.dev("M9", "s1", "c1", "vss", "vss", m_nm)
    n.dev("M10", "s2", "c1", "vss", "vss", m_nm)

    n.vsrc("vbp_src", "vbp", "vss", 1.8 - _vgs(m_pf))
    n.vsrc("vbpc_src", "vbpc", "vss", 1.8 - 0.35 - _vgs(m_pc))
    n.vsrc("vbnc_src", "vbnc", "vss", 0.3 + _vgs(m_nc))
    n.cap("CL", "out", "vss", 1e-12)

    gm1 = p["gmid_in"] * It / 2
    pred = {"ugb_hz": gm1 / (2 * 3.14159265 * 1.3e-12),
            "power_w": 1.8 * (It + 2 * Ifold + 10e-6),
            "gain_db": 55.0, "pm_deg": 70.0}
    return n, pred

netlist, prediction = build(PARAMS)
```
